items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I always inspired by John Kirby and Billy Taylor who was with Duke.

ctx.x: At this time were you into jazz that much that you had your favorites and you had some bass players who you favored and who you were inspired by.
Not yet. I always inspired by John Kirby and Billy Taylor who was with Duke.
This was a little later, right.
